knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

head(baseball_data)
```

```{r}
# Filtering out data that does not have estimated/expected (xBA) batting average values

baseball_data <- rename(baseball_data, xBA = estimated_ba_using_speedangle)
 xBA_baseball_data <- baseball_data |>
   filter(!is.na(xBA))

# Creating a new column that displays TRUE if the event was a hit, FALSE otherwise
xBA_baseball_data$is_hit <- xBA_baseball_data$events %in% hit_events
  
# Summarizing the aggregated xBA versus actual BA for 2015-2025
xBA_BA_summary <- xBA_baseball_data |>
  group_by(game_year) |>
  summarize(expected_batting_average = round(mean(xBA), 4), 
            actual_batting_average = round(mean(is_hit), 4),
            # Adding an actual BA minus xBA statistic for each year
            actual_minus_expected = actual_batting_average - expected_batting_average) |>
  # Combining xBA and actual BA into one column for data visualization
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(expected_batting_average, actual_batting_average),
    names_to = "BA_Type", 
    values_to = "BA"
  )

xBA_BA_summary
```

```{r}
# Five number summary for the actual_minus_expected BA values
delta_summary <- summary(xBA_BA_summary$actual_minus_expected)
delta_summary

# Checking for statistical outlier actual_minus_expected data
Q1 <- delta_summary[2]; Q3 <- delta_summary[5]
outlier_lower_bound <- Q1 - 1.5 * (Q3 - Q1)
outlier_lower_bound

# Filtering out the 2020 outlying actual_minus_expected statistic
xBA_BA_summary <- xBA_BA_summary |>
  filter(game_year != 2020)
  
# Plotting the two types of batting averages against the year
xBA_BA_plot <- ggplot(xBA_BA_summary, aes(x = as.factor(game_year), y = BA, color = BA_Type, group = BA_Type)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "MLB Actual vs Expected Batting Average (2015-2025)",
       x = "Season", 
       y = "Batting Average",
       color = "Batting Average Type") +
  # Renaming the color labels
  scale_color_discrete(labels = c("Actual Batting Average", "Expected Batting Average")) +
  theme_classic()

xBA_BA_plot
```

```{r}
# Plotting the actual_minus_expected BA values for each year, less 2020
delta_BA_plot <- ggplot(xBA_BA_summary, aes(x = as.factor(game_year), y = actual_minus_expected)) +
  # Creating a bar chart
  geom_col(fill = "salmon", color = "salmon") +
  labs(title = "MLB Actual Batting Average minus xBA (2015-2025)",
       x = "Season",
       y = "Actual BA - xBA",) +
  theme_classic()
delta_BA_plot
```
```{r}
# Computing linear regression statistics on actual_minus_expected BA versus year
delta_BA_linear_regression <- lm(actual_minus_expected ~ game_year, data = xBA_BA_summary)
summary(delta_BA_linear_regression)
```
